name: SAM 3.1
notes: Tier 1. Drop-in checkpoint upgrade to SAM3. Released 2026-03-27. Object Multiplex adds shared-memory joint multi-object tracking: up to 7x faster at 128 objects, double frame rate at medium counts, zero accuracy loss. Fully backwards-compatible API. Gated model — submit HF access request before downloading.

name: HyperSwap 256 (1a / 1b / 1c variants)
notes: Tier 1. Native 256x256 ONNX swap vs inswapper_128's 128x128 — 4x pixel count at comparable identity fidelity. Direct drop-in in ReActor (models/hyperswap/). Released June 2025; ReActor integration stable as of May 12 2026. Use hyperswap_1a first — active bug report on 1b black-circle artifact.

name: FLUX.2-Klein-9B SDNQ 4-bit
notes: Tier 1. SDNQ 4-bit quantisation of Klein-9B confirmed to fit 16 GB VRAM (tagged T4/16GB). Updated 2026-05-27 (in survey window). 735 downloads. Same Klein architecture — full LoRA compatibility, same flux2-vae. All 15 build_klein_* builders gain 9B quality without hardware changes.

name: Wan 2.7
notes: Tier 1 (verify weights first). 27B MoE, 14B active; Apache 2.0. Released April 2026. Adds native first+last-frame control, 9-grid I2V, reference-to-video, instruction editing, native 1080p. ComfyUI partner node confirmed (blog.comfy.org/p/wan27-is-now-available-in-comfyui). GGUF quants available. NOTE: HF API search returned only Wan2.2 repos at survey time — one agent confirmed weights, another could not. Verify at huggingface.co/Wan-AI before integrating.

name: HiDream-O1-Image 8B
notes: Tier 2. MIT license, released 2026-05-08-10; Dev-2604 variant with IP pipeline updated May 13-14. Pixel-level Unified Transformer (UiT) — no external VAE, no disjoint text encoder. Supports txt2img, instruction-based editing, subject-driven personalisation up to 2048x2048. 8B params; beats 27B Qwen-Image on multiple benchmarks. FP8 quant (drbaph/HiDream-O1-Image-FP8) fits 16 GB. ComfyUI native support confirmed (PR #13817). New builder warranted.

name: Microsoft Lens 3.8B + Lens-Turbo
notes: Tier 2. MIT license, released 2026-05-25 (in survey window). 3.8B DiT; dense-caption pre-training; multi-resolution up to 1440x1440; uses FLUX.2 semantic VAE. Lens-Turbo: 4-step inference at 0.84s on consumer GPU. ComfyUI PR #14077 open; weights mirrored under Comfy-Org. Fast-inference T2I path — does not replace SDXL/Flux/Klein but fills a new efficiency niche.

name: Sulphur-2 (LTX-Video 2.3 9B fine-tune)
notes: Tier 2. Apache 2.0, released 2026-05-03. Full 9B fine-tune of LTX-Video 2.3 on ~125k cinematic video clips. Same VAE and spatial upscaler as existing build_ltx_video stack — drop-in as alternate cinematic preset. 158k monthly HF downloads, 600+ likes. GGUF quants on Civitai. Note: NSFW-capable; review deployment policy.

name: RefControl FLUX.2-Klein-9B + 4B Reference-Depth LoRA
notes: Tier 2. Apache 2.0. Released 2026-05-27-28 (in survey window). Depth-conditioned ControlNet-style LoRA for Klein-9B (and 4B sibling at thedeoxen/refcontrol-FLUX.2-klein-4B-reference-depth-lora). Enables reference-image + depth-map guided img2img on Klein. First depth ControlNet for the Klein family — fills a major gap. 4B variant comfortably fits 16 GB.

name: IConFace (zhangjinyang/IConFace) + ComfyUI-Flux-FaceIR
notes: Tier 2. FLUX.2-Klein-base-4B LoRA (rank 16) for blind + reference-guided face restoration. Released 2026-05-04-06. Uses AdaFace identity anchoring; accepts 1-3 reference images for ID-consistent restoration. ComfyUI node: github.com/cosmicrealm/ComfyUI-Flux-FaceIR. Additive alongside CodeFormer when reference images available; replaces build_photo_restore for reference-guided path.

name: Anima base-v1.0
notes: Tier 2. Non-commercial license (CircleStone Labs x Comfy Org). Released 2026-05-14-15. 2B Illustrious-family-compatible anime/illustration model; zero synthetic training data; hybrid tag+natural-language prompting. 458k DL/mo. Drop-in as Illustrious-arch preset. Check licence before wiring.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap (Klein/Qwen instruction-based face swap)
notes: Tier 2. FLUX.2-Klein-4B/9B LoRA for diffusion-based face/head swap via instruction-based image editing. No ONNX/InsightFace required. Multiple community mirrors active April-May 2026. Seeds a new build_diffusion_faceswap pattern alongside ReActor.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video V3 (LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA)
notes: Tier 2. IC-LoRA for LTX-Video 2.3 for one-shot video head/face swap. Community mirrors appeared 2026-05-23-25 (in window). Requires ComfyUI-BFSNodes. VRAM fit on 16 GB with LTX-2.3 22B GGUF unconfirmed — test at lowest quantisation.

name: MoGe-2 (moge-2-vitl-normal)
notes: Tier 2. MIT license, ~1.5 GB. DINOv2 ViT-L; single forward pass yields metric-scale depth + surface normals simultaneously. Original weights July 2025; Comfy-Org package updated 2026-05-19 for ComfyUI v0.22.0. Custom node: github.com/zade23/ComfyUI-MoGe2. Additive unified alternative to running build_depth_map_v3 and build_normal_map separately.

name: Pixal3D
notes: Tier 2. MIT license. SIGGRAPH 2026. HF updated 2026-05-24 (in window). Pixel-aligned 3D from single image: back-projection pixel-to-3D correspondence, PBR textures, TRELLIS.2 backbone. No ComfyUI node yet. VRAM at lower resolutions likely fits 16 GB (verify).

name: TriSplat (scene 3D from unposed images)
notes: Tier 2. MIT license. GitHub: ziplab/TriSplat. Released 2026-05-25 (in window). Feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction using oriented triangle primitives; <1.3s from sparse unposed images; no camera poses needed. Scene-level complement to existing object-level build_hunyuan_3d_* builders. No ComfyUI node yet.

name: Netflix VOID (Video Object and Interaction Deletion)
notes: Tier 2. Apache 2.0. Released 2026-04-03; ComfyUI native in v0.21.0 (2026-05-11). Physics-aware video object removal: erases shadows and reflections of removed objects. CogVideoX-Fun-V1.5-5b-InP backbone (5B). Human-pref 64.8% vs Runway 18.4%. Netflix doc says 40 GB at 720p; quantised/lower-res may fit 16 GB — verify before marking Tier 1.

name: ComfyUI-TurboQuant (TQ3 KV-cache compression)
notes: Tier 2. Released 2026-05-18. TQ3 Lloyd-Max + Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform KV compression for DiT attention. ~4.5x VRAM reduction on attention KV cache. Applies non-destructively to any DiT model (Flux, Klein, LTX, WAN). No builder changes needed — install and activate per-workflow.

name: SANA-WM 2.6B world model
notes: Tier 2. Apache 2.0. Released 2026-05-14 (paper arXiv:2605.15178, 84 HF upvotes). NVIDIA; 720p/60-second video with 6-DoF camera trajectory control (pan/tilt/dolly/orbit). 36x throughput over prior OSS baselines. Specialised world-model — not a general T2V replacement for WAN/LTX but a new camera-control video builder.

name: Qwen-Image-2.0
notes: Tier 3 (weights not public yet). Paper 2026-05-11, 109 HF upvotes. Qwen3-VL encoder, 20B MMDiT, native 2K resolution, 1K-token prompts. Direct upgrade to build_qwen_edit when weights land. Apache 2.0 expected. Monitor QwenLM/Qwen-Image on HuggingFace.

name: Wan 2.7 (pending weight verification)
notes: Tier 3 fallback if weights cannot be verified. Multiple secondary sources report open weights under Apache 2.0 but HF API search did not surface Wan2.7 repos. Re-check huggingface.co/Wan-AI weekly.

name: HY-World 2.0 (Tencent)
notes: Tier 3. Updated 2026-05-21 (in window). Single-image full 3D world reconstruction. License: Tencent proprietary, non-commercial only. Skip until open license. Not a drop-in for object-level HunyuanVideo 3D builders.

name: Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance, API-only)
notes: Tier 3. ComfyUI partner API node April 2026; v0.22.0 adds auto-downscaling. No open weights — cloud API only. T2V + FLF2V + audio sync. Monitor for open-weight release.

name: DeSC-Face (NTIRE 2026 winner)
notes: Tier 3. CVPR 2026 workshop winner. FLUX.2-Klein-4B backbone + LoRA + structured control. No public weights. GitHub: github.com/jkwang28/NTIRE2026_RealWorld_Face_Restoration. Best-available diffusion face restorer if weights land.

name: LAFR (Latent Codebook Alignment for Blind Face Restoration)
notes: Tier 3. Paper 2025-05-29. SD-based codebook latent adapter; 0.9% of FFHQ training data; 70% training time reduction vs prior diffusion face restore. ICLR 2026 submission withdrawn. No public weights.

name: ERNIE-Image 8B (Baidu)
notes: Tier 3 (VRAM). Apache 2.0, released 2026-04-15. 8B DiT; GENEval 0.8728, LongTextBench 0.9733 (leading text-in-image scores). Turbo: 8-step. VRAM minimum 24 GB — exceeds 16 GB budget. Monitor for community quantisation to 16 GB.

name: Vision Banana (Google DeepMind generalist model)
notes: Tier 3 (no weights). Paper 2026-04-22. Single model beats SAM3 on segmentation and DA3 on metric depth. Also handles surface normals. No public weights — project page vision-banana.github.io only. If released, could unify build_sam3_*/build_depth_map_v3/build_normal_map into one builder.

name: Lightricks LTX-2.3 (already integrated)
notes: ALREADY INTEGRATED — workflows.py:10018 confirms ltxv/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors. Flagged as new by research agent but no action needed.
